annotations.title: Plan Korea inheritance gift filing deadline

description: Korean inheritance and gift tax filing deadlines (상증법 제67조·제68조): inheritance tax within 6 months (9 abroad) from the last day of the month of death, gift tax within 3 months from the last day of the month of the gift; also acquisition tax (지방세법 제20조), the deceased's income tax return, death report and renunciation deadlines, and the gift-return windows (제4조④). With tax and lateDays returns the 3% filing credit, no-filing penalty (20% with 50/30/20% relief for late filing within 1/3/6 months) and late-payment penalty (0.022% a day).

abroad.description: Deceased and all heirs live abroad (inheritance only)

lateDays.description: Days filed and paid after the deadline
